facts.text: The resort is located minutes from Tocumen International Airport and downtown Panama City, with easy access to Panama Viejo and Costa del Este.
facts.excerpt: Located minutes from Tocumen International Airport and downtown, the resort offers effortless access to Panama Viejo and Costa del Este.

facts.text: The centerpiece of the resort is a championship golf course designed by Jack Nicklaus.
facts.excerpt: The centerpiece of our Panama City, Panama golf resort is a lush, verdant championship golf course designed by the legendary Jack Nicklaus.

facts.text: The golf course is an 18-hole, par-72 layout with rippling fairways and sculpted bunkers that challenge both scratch handicappers and novice golfers.
facts.excerpt: this 18-hole, par-72 golf course features rippling fairways, beautiful greens and sculpted bunkers that offer a challenge for scratch handicappers and novice golfers alike.

facts.text: The golf course has four tee box locations to suit players of all ages and skill levels.
facts.excerpt: offers four tee box locations in order to accommodate players of all ages and skill levels

facts.text: The golf club offers rental equipment, professional lessons and a driving range.
facts.excerpt: offers top-notch rental equipment, professional lessons, and a driving range for practice

facts.text: Executive Suites feature Panamanian design elements: Mola bed runners inspired by Guna Yala, handmade baskets by the indigenous Embera community and wood sourced from Gatun Lake.
facts.excerpt: Mola bed runners inspired by Guna Yala, handmade baskets crafted by the indigenous Emberá community, and wood sourced from the depths of Gatun Lake.

facts.text: The decor is accented by handmade artifacts from Reprosa's Treasure of Panama, a company dedicated to preserving the country's history and cultural traditions.
facts.excerpt: The exquisite décor, all accented by handmade artifacts from Reprosa’s Treasure of Panama - the leading company in the preservation of the country’s history and cultural traditions

facts.text: The Master Suite is on the 7th floor and has a private terrace with golf course views.
facts.excerpt: The Master Suite is located on the 7th floor and features a private terrace with breathtaking golf course views

facts.text: The Master Suite and the Grand Suite each have a dining room, a guest bathroom and a living room.
facts.excerpt: privately set with a dining room, a guests' bathroom, living room and stunning golf course views

facts.text: Private terraces are available in select rooms.
facts.excerpt: Private terraces are available in select rooms.

facts.text: Room bathrooms are marble, with double vanities and lighted mirrors.
facts.excerpt: The marble bathrooms in our Panama City, Panama hotel rooms have double vanities and lighted mirrors

facts.text: The spa's Espiritu Santo Signature Massage is inspired by the Flor del Espiritu Santo, Panama's national flower.
facts.excerpt: The Espiritu Santo Signature Massage is inspired by the power and vitality of the Flor del Espiritu Santo

facts.text: Spa treatments include an array of massage, facial and body scrub options.
facts.excerpt: spa treatments with an array of massage, facial, and body scrub options

facts.text: Complimentary poolside cabanas are reserved for hotel guests.
facts.excerpt: Relax in style in our complimentary poolside cabanas, exclusive for guests.

facts.text: The pool has a view of the 18-hole course and the Panama City skyline.
facts.excerpt: pool with a view of the sprawling 18 holes and cosmopolitan Panama City

facts.text: Mestizo serves Panamanian cuisine with Mediterranean flair, and The Grill offers steak and seafood.
facts.excerpt: Savor gourmet Panamanian cuisine infused with Mediterranean flair at Mestizo or explore the sumptuous steak and seafood menu at The Grill.

facts.text: Mestizo offers three settings: the interior, a terrace or an outdoor plaza.
facts.excerpt: Choose from three atmospheres: the inviting interior, charming terrace, or vibrant outdoor plaza.

facts.text: Mestizo Bar is surrounded by artwork from local artists.
facts.excerpt: This bar in Panama City, Panama surrounds you with artwork from local artists

facts.text: AQVA Pool Bar has golf course views and outdoor terrace dining by the pool.
facts.excerpt: Enjoy views of the golf course at AQVA Pool Bar. Dine poolside on the outdoor terrace

facts.text: The concierge can arrange tours of the Panama Viejo ruins or trips to Casco Viejo.
facts.excerpt: Allow us to arrange a tour of the ruins of Panama Viejo or a trip to discover Casco Viejo

facts.text: The concierge can also arrange a day trip to a sandy beach or a rainforest.
facts.excerpt: take a day trip to a sandy beach or rainforest

facts.text: The ruins of Panama Viejo, remnants of the first European settlement on the Pacific Coast of the Americas, are minutes from the hotel.
facts.excerpt: Just minutes from The Santa Maria Hotel & Golf Resort, the ruins of Panama Viejo showcase the remnants of the first European settlement on the Pacific Coast of the Americas

facts.text: On arrival, guests enter a lush urban oasis surrounded by golf course views.
facts.excerpt: Upon arrival, guests are drawn into a lush Urban Oasis surrounded by extraordinary views of our golf course.
